scene: Inferno V — Minos at the threshold of the second circle
source: Dante Inferno V lines 1–24; subsequent Paolo and Francesca encounter reserved for a later intersection
originalStory: The second circle is narrower and more painful than the first. Minos hears each incoming soul confess, judges and signals its assigned depth by coils of his tail. He interrupts his work on noticing living Dante, warns him, and Virgil invokes the authority of their journey. They pass to the whirlwind.
